captions.detailed: A professional DSLR camera speedlight flash featuring a tall, rectangular black control body, a wide mounting shoe at the base, and a forward-facing rectangular flash head. The head assembly is mounted between two short yoke arms, exposing a horizontal tilt axis on both sides. The entire flash head and yoke assembly can swivel horizontally on a vertical revolute joint above the body, while the head itself tilts vertically on a horizontal revolute joint, and a distinct battery door panel is integrated on the side of the main body.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a professional camera flash accessory with a vertical main control body and a rectangular flash head. The flash head should swivel horizontally on a vertical joint above the body and tilt vertically on a horizontal axis between yoke arms, and include a separate side battery door panel.
captions.factory: Construct the camera flash using an ArticulatedObject assembly. Model the main body, mounting foot, and battery door as separate visual components of the base link using Box primitives. Create a swivel yoke assembly using a combination of horizontal and vertical Box primitives. Build the flash head as a rectangular Box with an inset glass panel. Define a vertical revolute joint connecting the body to the yoke, a horizontal revolute joint connecting the yoke to the flash head, and a side-hinged joint for the battery door.
